jobs.title: Experimental Scientist (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments.

As a Experimental Scientist, you’ll build experimental capability in Darmstadt and help execute compression experiments at ELI Beamlines and other external facilities. Focused Energy’s Target Physics Risk Mitigation project requires experimental validation of foam compression and hydrodynamic instability behaviour in wetted foam targets this is an important input to the company’s path to ignition.

You’ll bridge experiment and simulation by operating shock and compression diagnostics, analysing experimental data, and running radiation hydrodynamic simulations that can be compared directly with experimental results. Working alongside the foam compression team, you’ll help deliver the project’s Q1 2027 milestones.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own the execution of laser compression experiments at ELI Beamlines and other external facilities, including shot planning, diagnostic setup, and data collection.

  • Lead the operation of VISAR, SOP, and X-ray radiography diagnostics, building reliable procedures and deep diagnostic expertise within the foam compression team.

  • Drive radiation hydrodynamic simulations of foam compression and hydrodynamic instabilities using a multi-dimensional code such as FLASH or an equivalent.

  • Analyse experimental data comprehensively and document results in a form that supports physics interpretation and project reporting.

  • Compare simulation results with experimental data, clearly identifying areas of agreement, discrepancy, and uncertainty.

  • Build productive working relationships with ELI Beamlines and other facility partners to support beamtime access and campaign execution.

  • Improve the team’s understanding of foam compression and hydrodynamic instability physics by connecting experimental observations with simulation predictions.

  • Partner with Franzi Treffert, the Target Design team, and the simulation team on experimental planning, physics interpretation, and model validation.

 

Who You Are

  • You take ownership of your experimental and simulation workstream and manage day-to-day priorities without waiting for direction.

  • You are comfortable working independently in technically demanding, multidisciplinary environments.

  • You communicate experimental results, simulation findings, risks, and data-quality issues clearly in writing and team meetings.

  • You plan carefully and follow through across the full experiment cycle, from beamtime preparation through data analysis and reporting.

  • You use sound judgement when configuring diagnostics, selecting analysis approaches, and setting simulation parameters.

  • You recognise when a decision involves project priorities, experimental scope, or resource conflicts and escalate it appropriately.

  • You collaborate effectively with internal science teams and external laser-facility partners.

  • You are keen to build expertise, share reliable procedures, and support more junior contributors as the team grows.

 

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Experience with laser compression experiments in high-energy-density physics, inertial confinement fusion, or a closely related field.

  • Knowledge of hydrodynamic instabilities, including Rayleigh–Taylor and Richtmyer–Meshkov instabilities.

  • Practical experience operating shock and compression diagnostics such as VISAR, SOP, and X-ray radiography.

  • Experience with radiation hydrodynamic modelling using FLASH or an equivalent multi-dimensional simulation code.

  • Strong data analysis skills using Python or a comparable scientific computing language.

  • Experience with HPC simulation workflows and computational experiment pipelines.

  • Familiarity with experimental design and shot planning for laser facilities.

  • Knowledge of Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis, Bayesian optimisation, reproducible scientific analysis, and systematic result documentation.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
SoSafe is shifting from a broad-market approach to a deliberate, segment-led GTM model. This role is central to that transition. As Manager of Segment & Solutions Marketing, you will own the positioning, messaging, and solution architecture for SoSafe's priority segments. These can be defined by geography, industry vertical, customer lifecycle stage, or Human Risk maturity.

We have a foundation to build from: a defined maturity model that maps how organisations progress in their Human Risk journey, a growing understanding of how customer needs differ across lifecycle stages and a set of priority markets and geographies. What we don't yet have is the messaging, the plays, and the product experience layer that makes those segments feel served

Your role is to and translate that work into measurable improvements in win rates, market penetration, and net revenue retention. This is a newly created role in Product Marketing that you’ll have influence to shape and will work in close partnership with GTM, Product, Sales, CS, and the Commercial Centre of Excellence.

Location: This role can be fully remote from anywhere in Germany, or hybrid from one of our offices in Cologne, Munich or Berlin.

Segmented Messaging

  • Own messaging for defined priority segments — including lifecycle stage (new business, upsell, cross-sell, retention), maturity tier, geography, and industry vertical (e.g. financial services, manufacturing)

  • Develop segment-specific value propositions written in buyer language: the situation they face, the consequence of inaction, how SoSafe solves it, and why SoSafe over alternatives without jargon, no feature lists

  • Use AI tools to accelerate research, messaging iteration, persona development, and competitive synthesis as a standard part of your workflow

  • Maintain and evolve messaging as product capabilities, customer insights, and the competitive landscape shift — keeping SoSafe's market fit current and differentiated

  • Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitive dynamics to proactively inform segment strategy and portfolio planning

Solution Development

  • Define solution sets for priority segments: which SoSafe capabilities address their most pressing needs, framed around business outcomes rather than product features

  • Process voice-of-customer research, win/loss data, competitive intelligence, and regulatory context into compelling segment narratives and solution architectures

  • Partner with the Commercial CoE to inform pricing, packaging, bundling, and programme decisions — contributing market and segment evidence to commercial recommendations that drive share within defined segments

GTM Readiness

  • Develop SPICED-aligned talk tracks for each priority segment, grounding rep conversations in the buyer's situation before working back to solution language

  • Build and maintain a library of scalable, reusable field assets e.g. solution briefs, demo scripts, battle cards, objection-handling guides, buyer and implementation guides — leveraging AI to produce, iterate, and personalise at speed

  • Validate messaging and demo content before market release through structured rep feedback sessions, customer interviews, and early cohort exposure

  • Input into coordinated multi-touch plays across Marketing, Sales, and CS that drive upsell and cross-sell into the install base — with clear pipeline and NRR impact metrics tied to each play

  • Track asset utilisation, field feedback, and segment performance data (win rates, pipeline velocity, NRR contribution) to continuously improve GTM effectiveness and demonstrate commercial impact


What you will bring

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS in product marketing, solutions marketing or segment marketing with a proven track record of producing segment-specific or lifecycle-specific positioning

  • Demonstrated ability to write in buyer language: situation, problem, solution, outcome - not functional feature lists

  • Proficiency with competitive intelligence tools and a bias towards activating insight into sales & field-facing content, enriching the quality of their conversations

  • Proven AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to compress research cycles, pressure-test messaging, generate content variations, and move from insight to asset faster than a traditional workflow allows

  • Strong cross-functional operating skills, able to align Product, Sales, CS, and Commercial stakeholders around a segment strategy and drive execution

Preferred

  • Experience in cybersecurity, HR tech or a similarly technical B2B environment

  • Experience defining or contributing to solution sets and commercial packaging, not just messaging deliverables.

  • Background in structured pre-launch validation: rep councils, messaging test sessions, early cohort feedback

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n AI Solutions & Process Engineer, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren General Manager Energy Solutions und arbeitest eng mit unseren Tech- & Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Wen wir suchen

  • Digital Experience: Du entwickelst sowohl customer-facing als auch interne Tools entlang der User Journey, die uns im europäischem Energiemarkt einen strukturellen Wettbewerbsvorteil verschaffen. Dabei eliminierst du Friction, erhöhst Conversion Rates und schaffst so die Grundlage für skalierbares Wachstum.

  • User Journey: Du hast die Journey unserer Kunden und die dahinterliegenden Prozesse ganzheitlich im Blick – vom Erstkontakt mit einem Lead bis zum erfolgreichen Start einer Kundenbeziehung - gleichermaßen aus Kundenperspektive wie auch aus interner Sicht rund um operative Skalierbarkeit.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut.

  • Du hast eine Strategie für die Weiterentwicklung des Bereichs bei trawa entwickelt, klare Prioritäten gesetzt und eine Roadmap mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und Meilensteinen aufgesetzt, die unser weiteres Wachstum in Deutschland und die Expansion unterstützt.

  • Du hast dabei insbesondere erste Optimierungsprojekte zur Steigerung der Conversion Rates sowie zur internen Prozessoptimierung angestoßen - und erste Ergebnisse sind in Sicht.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Du kannst technische Lösungen nicht nur mit Low-Code oder Vibe-Coding Ansätzen umsetzen, sondern bist auch in der Lage, robusten Code zu entwickeln.

Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. You lead a regional team of Customer Value Partners, Data Scientists, and Implementation Consultants, and you sit between the Chief Customer Officer and the front line. This isn't a role where the playbook already exists and you just execute it, but it's also not a role where you build your own version in isolation. Much of the operational discipline, the services products, systems, and tools that make execution scalable, is still being built globally, and you're a core contributor to that single, globally deployable model, not the architect of a regional one. You carry the region's commercial outcomes, you carry escalations personally when they matter, and you help build the machine that gets deployed everywhere, starting here.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the regional commercial outcome: drive GRR and NRR across your portfolio of Customer Value Partner-managed accounts, and report on it with the same rigor you'd expect from your own team.

  • Contribute to Hawk's customer operating model, the delivery methodology, systems, and tools that make outcomes repeatable at scale, and roll it out in your region rather than building a parallel version of your own. You've seen what good looks like elsewhere and bring that judgment to a global effort, including coaching your Customer Value Partners as the model takes shape.

  • Lead and grow a cross-functional regional team, Customer Value Partners, Data Scientists, and Implementation Consultants, hiring, onboarding, and developing people as the region scales.

  • Be the last line of defense on escalations. When an account is genuinely at risk, you're the one on the governance call working the problem, not reading about it after the fact.

  • Partner with Sales as a credibility engine for the region: get pulled into pre-sale conversations, help scope engagements, and make sure what gets sold is something your team can actually deliver.

  • Run regular business reviews with Sales and company leadership covering forecasting, account health, and where the region's growth is actually coming from.

  • Work with your peer Heads of Customer and the functions that own the global model to keep your region aligned: feed regional learnings back in, adopt changes as they roll out, and flag where local market realities genuinely require an exception rather than a workaround.

  • Own people development across the region: performance reviews, career planning, and skills coverage across the CVP, Data Science, and Implementation Consultant roles, so the region is never one departure away from a delivery gap.

  • Represent the region in leadership conversations, giving the CCO and the rest of the leadership team an honest, evidence-based read on regional health, risk, and opportunity.

Your Profile

  • 10+ years leading and managing professional services or delivery organizations within B2B enterprise software. This means you've actually run a PS team, owned utilization, staffing, and delivery quality across a book of engagements, not just managed customer success or account relationships.

  • A genuine builder who plays well with a global standard. You've contributed to or helped roll out a services operating model across multiple markets before, delivery methodology, tooling, staffing model, and you understand the difference between adapting a global model locally and quietly building your own. You can point to what you contributed and why it worked.

  • A track record of owning a commercial number, GRR, NRR, revenue, or bookings, and hitting it, not just influencing it from the side.

  • Real experience managing a team through escalations. You've been the person on the call when an account was genuinely at risk, not just the person who heard about it afterward.

  • Comfortable with SaaS and services financial metrics (GRR, NRR, utilization) and can read a regional forecast without someone translating it for you.

  • Strong hiring instincts. You've built or scaled a team before, and you know the difference between a candidate who interviews well and one who'll actually do

  • the job.

  • Genuine comfort operating at C-suite level, with customers and with internal stakeholders alike.

  • Strong grasp of SaaS and enterprise software delivery models; experience in AML, fraud prevention, or another regulated financial services domain is a real advantage, not a nice-to-have footnote.

  • Fluent in German, in addition to fluent English.

Bonus

  • Experience leading a team spanning multiple functions (delivery, data science, technical implementation) rather than a single-discipline team.

jobs.title: Co-Founder:in Growth m/w/d
jobs.description:
HR Buddys ist die All-in-one-HR-Plattform für Startups, wachsende Unternehmen und gehobenen Mittelstand. Wir verbinden Software und Managed-HR-Services: von Core HR und Recruiting über Talent Management, Benefits bis zu Insights — und begleiten Unternehmer:innen so weit, dass sie sich auf Produkt und Wachstum konzentrieren können, während wir HR professionell aufsetzen.

Unser Modell unterscheidet sich bewusst von reinen SaaS-Playern wie Factorial oder Personio: Neben der Plattform (inkl. Apply und Hire) liefern wir echte HR-Expertise — Employer Branding, Recruiting, Administration und Beratung. Die Nachfrage ist da; jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Sales und Marketing im Leadership Team als Wachstumsmotor führt.

Wir suchen eine:n Co-Founder:in Growth, die:der mit uns Ownership übernimmt — nicht „nur“ eine Head-of-Rolle, sondern Mitgestaltung von Go-to-Market, Marke, Pipeline und Revenue auf Augenhöhe mit den bestehenden Gründern.

Aufgaben

  • Gesamtverantwortung Sales & Marketing im Leadership Team: Strategie, Budget, Prioritäten und Ergebnisse für ARR, Pipeline und Markenbekanntheit.
  • Go-to-Market für HR Buddys (Core HRIS, Apply, Hire) und das Managed-Services-Angebot schärfen und skalieren — klarer ICP (Startups & SMEs, typisch 5–50 Mitarbeitende), Positionierung gegen etablierte HR-SaaS-Wettbewerber.
  • Outbound- und Inbound-Sales aufbauen: Demo-to-Close, Pricing-/Packaging-Feedback, Enterprise-Deals, Partner- und Channel-Ansätze (z. B. Steuerberater:innen, PE/VC, HR-Beratung).
  • Marketing-Engine aufbauen: Content, Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Events, Employer-/Product-Brand im DACH-Raum (und perspektivisch weitere Märkte); messbare Funnel-Metriken statt reiner Sichtbarkeit.
  • Selbstsignup & PLG mit Paid/Upsell verbinden: Free-Tier (bis 10 Nutzer:innen) als Einstieg nutzen, Conversion in Professional/Enterprise und Services aktiv steuern.
  • Team aufbauen: erste Sales- und Marketing-Hires führen, Prozesse (CRM, Playbooks, Reporting) etablieren und Kultur von Ownership und Tempo vorleben.
  • Mitgründen im engeren Sinn: Produkt-, Pricing- und Roadmap-Entscheidungen mitprägen, Kund:innenstimme ins Leadership bringen, Investor:innen- und Partnergespräche mittragen, wo sinnvoll.
  • Zahlen führen: Forecast, Pipeline-Hygiene, CAC/LTV, Win-Rates, Content-ROI — und daraus wöchentlich die richtigen Prioritäten ableiten.

Qualifikation

  • Sehr starker Aktivierungsgrad, Dynamik und Hunger.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in B2B-Sales und/oder Growth-Marketing in SaaS, idealerweise HR Tech, Productivity oder angrenzenden Verticals; ideal mit eigener Verantwortung für Revenue oder einen klaren Growth-Funnel
  • Nachweislich Deals geschlossen und Demand generiert — du kennst den Weg von Awareness über Demo bis Contract und kannst ihn skalierbar machen
  • Starke Positionierungs- und Storytelling-Kompetenz: du kannst ein komplexes Angebot (Software + Services) für Gründer:innen, Mittelständler:innen und HR-Entscheider:innen einfach und überzeugend machen
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: du verkaufst und schreibst selbst, baust Funnels, testest Kanäle — und holst erst dann Team nach, wenn der Repeatable Motion steht
  • Affinität zu Startups und KMU sowie Verständnis für deren Kaufverhalten (schnelle Entscheidungen, Budgetdisziplin, Vertrauen vor Feature-Listen)
  • Erfahrung im DACH-Markt (Sprache, Netzwerke, Kanäle); weitere Sprachen (EN plus FR/IT/ES) sind ein Plus — unsere Plattform ist mehrsprachig
  • Bereitschaft zur echten Co-Founder-Rolle: Equity-Mindset, Ambiguity-Toleranz, hohe Eigenverantwortung, Wille, in einer frühen Phase Unsicherheit und Tempo mitzutragen
  • Idealerweise erste Führungserfahrung und Freude daran, ein kleines, starkes Growth-Team aufzubauen
  • Bachelor oder Master in BWL oder ein vergleichbarer Abschluss
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Benefits

Individuelle Unternehmensbeteiligung

Wir freuen uns, mit Dir ins Gespräch zu kommen, wenn Du Lust hast, Sales und Marketing als Mitgründer:in zu verantworten, Kund:innen zu gewinnen und eine Marke im HR-Markt aufzubauen, die Software und echte HR-Partnerschaft verbindet, unsere Firma in der nächsten Growth Phase aktiv mit zu gestalten und von Beginn an starken Einfluss auf das Geschäftsmodell und das Team zu nehmen, freuen wir uns auf den Austausch.

Bewerbung: Kurzes Motivationsschreiben (warum HR Buddys, warum Co-Founder, was du in den ersten 90 Tagen anpacken würdest) plus LinkedIn/CV an die Gründer:innen — oder direkt ein Gespräch mit Co-Founder Matthias Busold unter 0171-7641268 vereinbaren.

Wir gestalten Vergütung, Equity und Arbeitsmodell gemeinsam so, dass sie zur Verantwortung und zum gemeinsamen Risiko passen.
